skill.name: subagent-development
skill.description: Guides iterative implementation by assigning one subagent per plan task and adding code review checkpoints between tasks.
skill.summary: Run plan tasks through isolated subagents with review gates after each task.
skill.author: DMJGilbert

content.value_statement: Complex implementation plans can lose quality when tasks share stale context. This skill guides isolated subagent execution with review checkpoints after every task.
actual_capabilities: Turns an existing implementation plan into tracked task work.
Directs one fresh implementation subagent for each task.
Adds code review checkpoints after every completed task.
Defines actions for critical, high, medium, and low review findings.
Provides a final review template before merge or pull request work.
limitations: Requires an existing implementation plan with mostly independent tasks.
Does not define project architecture or product requirements.
Assumes subagent and reviewer tools are available in the host assistant.
Can add process overhead for small changes.

use_cases.title: Execute a phased implementation plan
use_cases.description: Run each plan task in a fresh context and review work before moving forward.

use_cases.title: Add review gates to AI-assisted changes
use_cases.description: Use reviewer checkpoints to catch regressions, missing tests, and requirement drift after each task.

use_cases.title: Resume long-running work safely
use_cases.description: Track task status and deferred issues so work can pause without losing context.

prompt_templates.title: Run a plan step by step
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner workflow for a prepared plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use subagent-development on this plan. Create the task list, dispatch one fresh subagent per task, review after each task, and stop for critical issues.

prompt_templates.title: Implement with TDD gates
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate workflow with tests before implementation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to implement the plan with TDD. For each task, request a failing test, minimal implementation, passing tests, and review.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate dependent tasks
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow when some tasks depend on earlier work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use subagent-development, but identify dependencies before dispatch. Only start the next task after critical and high review findings are resolved.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a completed task sequence
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow before merge or pull request preparation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the final review step to these commits. Check plan compliance, architecture, regressions, and unresolved review items before recommending merge readiness.

output_examples.input: A user provides a five-task refactor plan.
output: Creates a tracked task list from the plan.
Runs Task 1 in an isolated implementation context.
Sends the completed task to a reviewer before continuing.
Documents any deferred medium or low issues.

output_examples.input: A reviewer reports a high priority regression after Task 2.
output_examples.output: The skill directs the assistant to fix the issue before starting Task 3 and request another review checkpoint.

output: Runs a final review against the original plan.
Checks for regressions and unresolved review items.
Transitions to merge or pull request workflow when ready.

best_practices: Start with a reviewed plan before using this skill.
Keep each subagent task small enough to test and review.
Resolve critical and high review findings before continuing.
anti_patterns: Do not use it for quick edits that do not need task isolation.
Do not run multiple implementation subagents in parallel.
Do not skip reviewer feedback because tests passed.

faq.question: Does this skill create the implementation plan?
faq.answer: No. It assumes a plan already exists and helps execute it with review checkpoints.

faq.question: Can it run tasks in parallel?
faq.answer: No. The workflow requires one implementation subagent at a time to keep review order clear.

faq.question: Does it require test-driven development?
faq.answer: Yes. The process asks each implementation subagent to write a failing test before code changes.

faq.question: What happens when a critical issue is found?
faq.answer: The workflow stops forward progress until the issue is fixed and reviewed again.

faq.question: Is it compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: When should I avoid this skill?
faq.answer: Avoid it for small edits, tightly dependent tasks, or plans that still need review.
